user_preferences.interaction_style: Direct, task-driven, and highly detailed. The user prefers structured execution without repeated question cycles.
user_preferences.technical_focus: Python 3.12+ Game Loop/ECS (Entity Component System) Engine coupled with Behavior Tree AI controllers and custom Computer Vision perception layers. Core technologies include ModernGL + PyGLM + GLFW for 3D physics/HUD, OpenCV + PyTesseract + ONNX Runtime/YOLO for perception, PyAutoGUI + Playwright for OS/browser automation, and DearPyGui for GUI/HUD orchestration.
user_preferences.goal_orientation: Developing and refining SerpAuto, a high-performance game-like automation and training engine supporting multiple mode strategies (Gymnasium, Architect, Production, Teacher) and reactive swarm steering.

project_knowledge.overview: SerpAuto is an AI-driven, Game-Loop-based ECS Automation and Simulation Engine. It combines visual perception pipelines (OCR, YOLO object detection, template matching), behavior-tree-based cognitive systems, and OS-level automation inside a synchronized, multi-phase ticking game loop.

architecture.main_principle: Game Loop & Entity Component System (ECS) architecture. Updates are broken down into sequential phases (`SystemPhase`) executed under mode-specific strategies (`ModeStrategy`). The engine processes ticks at a target TPS (default 60) via non-blocking asynchronous sleep compensation.
system_phases: INPUT: Reads hardware, window events, or virtual driver inputs.
MAIL_ROUTING: Internal message routing and system communication.
PERCEPTION: Executes Computer Vision, OCR, and AI detection filters (MSS, cv2, pytesseract, YOLO).
INTERNAL_PHYSICS: Calculates movements, swarm steering forces, and collision checks.
COGNITION: Executes Behavior Tree mind ticks via custom registry-backed nodes.
EXECUTION: Translates cognitive intents into actions, emulating inputs (PyAutoGUI, Playwright) or simulation updates.
REWARD: Computes fitness metrics or rewards for Gymnasium-based learning modes.
TELEMETRY: Broadcasts stats, frames, and state snapshots.

mode_strategies.ARCHITECT: Development mode featuring visual graph editors, manual system overrides, and inspectors.
mode_strategies.PRODUCTION: Optimized execution mode with minimal GUI overhead, maximizing throughput and automation reliability.
mode_strategies.GYMNASIUM: Reinforcement learning training mode exposing a gym-compatible interface for model training.
mode_strategies.TEACHER: Interactive mode allowing manual override of system actions for demonstration or demonstration recording.

architecture.registry_and_ecs: The central `Registry` acts as a decorator-driven mapping hub. Components are registered via `@Registry.register_component` (assigning unique bitmask indices for efficient ECS queries). Systems are registered via `@Registry.register_system` mapped to their phase and active modes. Behavior tree nodes are registered via `@Registry.register_node`.
architecture.gui_and_event_bus: Asynchronous messaging decoupled via `GUIEventBus` supporting events such as ENGINE_PLAY, ENGINE_PAUSE, ENGINE_STEP, and snapshot serialization/deserialization. Interactive panels are dynamically assembled via `auto_ui_builder` which maps ECS entity components directly to DearPyGui widgets.

abcs.name: System
abcs.usage: Base class for all ECS logic phases containing optional accumulator-based fixed-timestep ticking logic.

abcs.name: BaseComponent
abcs.usage: Base representation of ECS components containing state without logic.

abcs.name: PerceptionNode
abcs.usage: Base processing filter class inside the CV/perception pipeline.

abcs.name: ModeStrategy
abcs.usage: Interface representing system collection for specific execution modes.

register_component.name: register_component
register_component.purpose: Registers a component class and generates its bitmask for ECS filtering.

register_system.name: register_system
register_system.purpose: Registers an ECS system class mapped to target phases, priorities, and execution modes.

register_node.name: register_node
register_node.purpose: Registers a cognitive Behavior Tree node with category, icon, and description metadata.

standard_decorators.@abstractmethod: Enforces override patterns on `System.update`, `PerceptionNode.process`, and BT nodes.

async_patterns.async_functions: The main game loop (`run()`), ticking system (`_tick()`), and all ECS updates (`System.update()`) are asynchronously designed to allow lightweight cooperative multitasking during automated waiting periods.
async_patterns.tps_sleep_compensation: Ensures that tick times are accurately regulated via `await asyncio.sleep(max(0, target_tick_time - elapsed))` to maintain stable, non-blocking TPS rates.

descriptor_protocol.usage: Standard properties (`@property`) are used for lightweight component lookups and entity status querying.

context_managers.usage: Standard context managers are used in tests for UI mocking and resource cleanups.

metaclass_usage.usage: Standard type hierarchies are used; no custom metaclasses are implemented in the engine.

pydantic_patterns.usage: SystemMetadata, NodeMetadata, and structural configuration models are modeled using Pydantic V2 to enforce runtime validation.

import_patterns.lazy_imports: Heavy scientific and CV modules (cv2, pytesseract, numpy, dearpygui) include safety import-guards (`try...except ImportError`) or inside local helper hooks, enabling test isolation without physical GUI/display servers.

engine_core.domain: ECS Engine & Synchronization. Manages entities, component storage lists, tick phases, and mode-based system resolution.
key_components: SerpentineEngine (core/engine.py): Main event loop runner handling pause, play, single-stepping, and snapshot files.
World (core/world.py): ECS container managing entity instantiation, component bitmask arrays, and raw state snapshots.
Registry (core/registry.py): Central schema metadata container for systems, nodes, and components.

perception_pipeline.domain: Visual computer vision & detection pipeline. Processes screen capture observations into structured grids and template locations.
key_components: PerceptionNode (perception/nodes.py): Pipeline filter classes including CropNode, GrayscaleNode, TemplateMatchNode, OCRNode, and InternalGridPerception.
Pipeline (perception/pipeline.py): Sequences multiple perception nodes to build a comprehensive environmental observation.

mind_bt.domain: Cognitive Behavior Tree engine. Translates observations into strategic actions using a custom decorator-wrapped node registry.
key_components: Brain (mind/brain.py): Evaluates the active BT structure against the blackboard.
Composites (mind/composites.py): Selection, Sequence, and parallel nodes.
Actions (mind/actions.py): Execution leaves for UI clicking, steering, and model querying.

rendering_hud.domain: 3D simulation rendering & HUD. Manages GPU buffers, context initialization, GLFW windows, and shader loops.
key_components: RenderSystem (systems/render/system.py): Coordinates moderngl vertex buffers, camera transforms via PyGLM, and GLFW callbacks.
Raycast (systems/render/raycast.py): Executes fast bounding-box intersection calculations in 3D world coords.

testing_deep_analysis.total_test_files: 14 test files in tests/ directory, fully evaluating ECS, BT, cv, raycast, and simulation components.

conftest_hierarchy.purpose: Mocks the `dearpygui` package and its core context managers on the standard `sys.modules` list to allow running GUI tests on headless CI runners.

patterns.mocking: Extensive use of MagicMocks for dearpygui, allowing full builder validation without graphics devices.
patterns.isolated_assertion: Checks system accumulator timing, ray-box intersections, and BT status transitions (SUCCESS/RUNNING/FAILURE).

gaps: Hardware-dependent pyautogui automation flows are minimally covered by pure unit tests due to native OS integration barriers.

architectural_decisions.title: Game-Loop ECS Architecture
architectural_decisions.decision: Run automation flows inside a continuous async game loop divided into sequential phases instead of standard request-response structures.

architectural_decisions.title: Abstract Perception Nodes
architectural_decisions.decision: CV and AI processes must be framed as decoupled PerceptionNodes processing immutable Observations, enabling pipeline reusability.

architectural_decisions.title: Headless GUI Testing via Mocks
architectural_decisions.decision: Mock the entire dearpygui module inside pytest's configure hook to ensure CI runners remain fast and visual-free.

error_handling_strategy.exception_hierarchy: System update execution is safe-guarded to prevent a crash in one phase from halting the whole engine loop. Errors are intercepted at the system tick boundary, logged via serpentine.log, while continuing loop processing.
